description: Muted blue-green crossed-front long coat with gold-brown curled geometric woven borders, cream layered sleeves showing below wider outer cuffs, decorated broad woven sash and leather belt with metal disks and fringed hanging end, loose light brown trousers and dark leather boots. Both hands hang at the sides and full hair and shoes have margins. No headgear, armor, weapon or text. Moderate physique is concealed by generously fitted woven layers.
